name: Surge-arrester earth-lead interface
aliases: switchyards Switchyard earthing and lightning interfaces
summary: Identifies the earth connection serving the selected primary surge arrester.
description: Identifies the earth connection serving the selected primary surge arrester. Earthing and lightning interfaces identify the connections between equipment metalwork, primary protection devices and the station earthing network. Their electrical purpose differs from their physical conductor route or electrode geometry.

In a switchyard arrangement, the earthing references help connect each primary equipment structure and surge-protection device to the correct earth-grid interface. Separate details show actual joints, sizes and installation routes. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Arrester earth terminal” at the input and “Station earthing network” at the output. Physical lead arrangement affects the application.

Name every connected item and the earthing design reference. The illustrative connection does not establish touch or step voltages, conductor sizing, lightning coverage or safe working conditions.
